The sentiment trend described shows a clear deterioration over time. Initially, the product was likely received with some level of acceptance or positivity, but one month post-release, frustration has set in due to unresolved software issues and a perceived lack of timely updates. This has led to a shift where negative reviews are outnumbering positive ones, indicating a worrying downward trajectory in user satisfaction.

Regarding the primary material of a candle: The primary material of a candle is wax. Common types of wax include paraffin wax (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honey bees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and palm wax. The wax serves as the fuel source that melts and is drawn up the wick to sustain the flame.
